Staging (test builds): vault release log

Staging release 25 (test build)

Release 25 adds voting with services you are connected to, and makes sign-in requests from services easier to check.

Status

Status
Active
Published
2026-10-31
End date
Not set

The current release. New vaults are enrolled into it, and the app offers it to everyone on an older release.

Changes

  • You can now vote on proposals from a service you are connected to. Your vault creates the voting key, signs your ballot, keeps the proof, and checks the published results to confirm your ballot is in them as you cast it.
  • Sign-in requests from a service now show a short match code, so you can check that the request on your phone is the one on the service's screen.
  • A service can now withdraw a sign-in request it no longer needs. Your phone shows it as no longer waiting instead of asking you.
  • Connections to services are now limited to sign-in, voting and profile updates: a service cannot send you messages, ask for your data or location, or call you, and you cannot message, call or share your location or data with a service.
  • Services receive your profile without your photo or profile items.
  • When you deny, end or unlink a device's access, or grant a pairing, the vault now records it in your History and tells your other devices.
  • Built from vettid-vault commit bc5660f (tag release/staging/25) and independently rebuilt on 2026-10-31 with a matching PCR0.

Security

No security fix
